member.name: T:ElBruno.QwenTTS.Pipeline.OrtSessionHelper
member.summary:
Helper methods for creating ONNX Runtime SessionOptions with different execution providers.
Usage: Pass the desired factory method to TtsPipeline or VoiceClonePipeline constructors. The consumer must reference the appropriate NuGet package for their chosen GPU backend: - CPU (default): Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime - CUDA: Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Gpu - DirectML: Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.DirectML
Note: GPU NuGet packages are mutually exclusive — only one can be referenced per project.
